title: VFusion3D: Learning Scalable 3D Generative Models from Video Diffusion Models
caption: Fig. 2: The pipeline of VFusion3D. We first use a small amount of 3D data to fine-tune a video diffusion model, transforming it into a multi-view vodeo generator that functions as a data engine. By generating a large amount of synthetic data, we train VFusion3D to generate a 3D representation and render novel views.
